stock.description: Oriental Payment Group Holdings Limited functions as a payment facilitator, providing transaction processing solutions to Thai businesses that serve Chinese tourists. The company empowers these merchants to accept a diverse range of international digital payment methods, encompassing major credit and debit cards, QR code systems, Near Field Communication (NFC) technology, and other contemporary electronic payment innovations. Furthermore, it offers marketing and administrative assistance, as well as specialized environmental, social, and governance (ESG) reporting and consultation services. The firm was founded in 2004 and is primarily based in Bangkok, Thailand.
